programs.title: Grant

programs.title: The Harlem Hellfighters: Unsung Heroes
programs.desc: Robin Roberts narrates this insightful documentary that explores the leadership, sacrifice and valor of the 15th National Guard, which would become a part of the 369th Infantry and one of WWI's best military regiments.

programs.title: Tuskegee Airmen: Legacy of Courage
programs.desc: Exploring the legacy of the Tuskegee Airmen, the legendary group of African American pilots, revealing how these warriors for change helped end segregation in the military and pave the way for the civil rights movement.

programs.title: After Jackie
programs.desc: The story of the second wave of talented Black baseball players after Jackie Robinson, including Bill White, Curt Flood and Bob Gibson, who were up next in the fight for racial equality.

programs.title: Triumph: Jesse Owens and the Berlin Olympics
programs.desc: The dramatic tale of Owens' athletic dedication, perseverance and triumph over Hitler's Aryan supremacy agenda.

programs.desc: As the world edged toward another World War, Joe Louis and Max Schmeling's battles for boxing's heavyweight crown became symbols of a global showdown between FDR's vision of democracy and Hitler's violent fascism.
